thread:
Alex: Heads up — analyst briefing window for the product launch next Wed. Need to lock 30-min slots for EMEA/APAC folks and confirm embargo timing. Who can take scheduling?
Marie: Can we shift the embargo to 2025-11-03 14:00 UTC? One analyst asks to move because of a conflicting vendor brief.
Ben: I can own scheduling. My availability next Wed: 09:00–11:30 PST and 16:00–18:00 PST. Will map to EMEA/APAC slots and send calendar invites.
Jamal: Quote draft is here, short version for press: "Redwood Inference delivers production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and material cost savings for product teams." Marie — can you review tone?
Marie: Small tweak: drop the word "revolutionary" and use "production-grade". Also please call out p95 latency, not average.
Priya: fact-check: the published latency number should be "p95 = 95ms on c4 instance with batching=8" — double-check the table in the doc.
Jamal: copied. I'll update to p95 and swap the latency row. Updated quote: "Redwood Inference delivers production-grade LLM inference with predictable p95 latency and material cost savings for engineering teams."
Alex: Nice. Marie, is that green for press? We need a final signed quote for the press packet before embargo.
Marie: Green with one more change — add "with unified rollout controls" at the end. So: "...cost savings for engineering teams, with unified rollout controls."
Jamal: Finalized and pasted into the press doc. Link: https://docs.example.com/press/launch-quote (private)
PressBot: Automated notice: Embargo candidate set to 2025-11-03T14:00:00Z — awaiting final quote attachment to press packet.
Ben: I'll attach the final doc and send invites once Jamal confirms quote is in the packet. Who should be CC'd on invites? Suggest: product-leads, comms, legal.
Alex: CC: Marie, Jamal, Priya, legal@redwood.com. Also include the analyst desk contact list.
Priya: Quick check — the benchmark table uses tokens-per-second. Make sure units are clear. I updated the table caption: "throughput (tokens/s) at batch=8".
Marie: Thanks. Ben, please hold the 16:00 PST slot for EMEA overlap in case APAC shifts.
Ben: Will do. Sending invites in ~30m.
Alex: One more ops note — if an analyst requests an embargo extension, route to me + comms for approval, and update PressBot with the new time.
Marie: :thumbsup: Good call. Also flag: if any direct quote edits are requested by press, we need comms + legal sign-off (low-latency path).
Jamal: Understood. I'll keep a change log in the doc and ping here with final timestamp once attached.
PressBot: Reminder: attach final-quote.txt to /press/packets/launch-2025 before changing embargo.
Marie: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. :wave:
Jamal: Final attachment done. Marking thread resolved unless anyone needs a swap.
Alex: Closing loop — Ben, send calendar invites and confirm when done.
Ben: Invites sent to list with calendar attachments and dial-in. Marking scheduled. :white_check_mark:
